api.manageKeysHint: Create, enable/disable, set quotas, and revoke API keys. Management lives under Settings.
detail.proxyFormatError: Format: socks5://host:port, http://host:port, or direct to bypass global proxy
apiKeys.listHint: Create multiple keys; each tracks usage and limits independently.
apiKeys.requireHint: When enabled, all /v1/* requests must include Authorization: Bearer <key> or X-Api-Key.
apiKeys.requireWithoutEnabledKeyWarning: No enabled API key found (legacy keys migrated from older configs are kept disabled). Enabling authentication now will reject every /v1/* request. Enable or create a key first — continue anyway?
apiKeys.empty: No API keys yet. Click the button on the right to add one.
apiKeys.formKeyEditPlaceholder: Current: {0} — leave blank to keep, or type a new value
apiKeys.modelHint: Tick one or more allowed models. A client model in the list passes through; one not in the list is remapped to the first ticked model. Leave all unticked to accept the client's requested model. The global Force Model setting overrides this.
apiKeys.rateLimitHint: Windowed rate limit over 60s. 0 = unlimited. Exceeding returns HTTP 429 with Retry-After.
settings.publicBaseURLHint: Externally reachable URL of this proxy, e.g. https://azr.hian.software. Used to build OAuth redirect_uri so SSO login works behind a custom domain instead of localhost. Leave empty to auto-detect from the request.
settings.limitNoticePlaceholder: Your API key has reached its limit or has expired. Please contact the administrator to renew it.
settings.limitNoticeHint: Friendly in-chat reply shown to a client whose key is disabled, expired, over-limit, or blocked by IP rules. Leave empty to use the built-in default.
settings.forceModelHint: When set, EVERY request is rewritten to this model regardless of what the client sent or which model a key is bound to. Choose "Off" to respect the client's model. Takes effect on the next request.
settings.identityModelHint: When set, a "You are <model>" line is injected into the system prompt so the assistant self-reports as this model when asked, regardless of the real upstream model. Choose "Off" to leave identity to the model's own training. Takes effect on the next request.
settings.identityModelWarn: We devs suffer a lot — please be a dev with a conscience and leave this feature off.
apilog.title: API Request Log
apilog.hint: Recent requests per API key, with tokens and credits consumed each request. In-memory only (last 1000), cleared on restart.
settings.maxPayload: Max payload size (per-request byte cap sent to AWS)
settings.maxPayloadAggressive: 2.1 MB · Aggressive · ~860k tokens · near AWS ~2.15MB limit
settings.maxPayloadMax: 4.0 MB · Max · try ~1M (AWS still blocks ~2.15MB, no safety net)
settings.maxPayloadHint: AWS hard-limits ~2.15MB. Exceeding it = request fails with 400, no retry. Applies immediately, no restart needed.
apiKeys.expiresAtHint: Key stops authenticating after this time. Leave empty to never expire.
apiKeys.rpmLimitHint: Throttles requests per minute by delaying (not rejecting). 0 = unlimited.
apiKeys.ipLimitHint: Max distinct client IPs allowed to use this key at once. 0 = unlimited.
apiKeys.ipAllowlistPlaceholder: One IP or CIDR per line, e.g. 203.0.113.7 or 10.0.0.0/24
apiKeys.ipAllowlistHint: When non-empty, only listed IPs/CIDRs may use this key. One per line.
apiKeys.tpmLimitHint: Tokens-per-minute metadata for reference; not enforced. 0 = unlimited.
apiKeys.confirmResetAll: Reset ALL counters for "{0}", including the lifetime total? This cannot be undone.
apiKeys.boundAccountsHint: This key routes only through the selected account(s). Leave all unchecked to use the shared pool. If none of the bound accounts is usable (cooldown, over quota, or missing the requested model) the request falls back to the shared pool.
apiKeys.boundAccountsEmpty: No accounts available. Add an account first.

api.quickStartKeyPlaceholder: Paste an API key to test and fill examples

api.quickStartTestUnauthorized: Key rejected (401). Check the key or enable API key verification.
apiKeys.showWarning: Copy and store this key now. It will not be shown in plaintext again.
apikey.keyMissing: Please enter a Kiro API key

customApi.orderIdPlaceholder: e.g. ORD-1234 or a label for this key
detail.modelAccessHint: Restrict which models this account may serve. Leave all checked for no restriction. Uncheck a model to prevent this account from serving it — useful to pin a model to specific accounts.
detail.modelAccessNoneSelected: Select at least one model, or allow all
detail.regionOverrideHint: Pin which AWS region this account's requests target, overriding the region auto-derived from the profile. Empty = automatic (default). Changing it re-resolves the profile in the new region and may take one request to settle; if the account has no profile in that region, requests fail closed rather than routing elsewhere. Auth region is unaffected.
detail.regionOverrideInvalid: Invalid region — use an AWS region like us-east-1, or leave empty to clear
diag.title: Account Diagnostics
externalIdpDiag.desc: Static checks for imported external IdP accounts. Live checks run only when you click them.
externalIdpDiag.liveSuccess: External IdP live refresh check passed
externalIdpDiag.title: External IdP Diagnostics
forecast.creditsNote: Read-only projection in AWS agentic-request credits. Burn rate uses total upstream consumption since the period baseline. Accounts show 'unknown' until ~10 minutes after a baseline is captured.
forecast.desc: Projects when each account's remaining period quota will be exhausted at its observed burn rate. Read-only; no routing changes.
forecast.title: Fleet Capacity Forecast
health.desc: Rolling per-account health score from recent request outcomes. Spots a degrading credential (auth/suspended/profile errors) before it hard-bans. Benign quota errors are excluded.
health.heuristicNote: Heuristic degradation score, not a validated ban predictor. AWS does not publish pre-ban signals; this scores observable failure patterns over the recent window.
health.title: Account Health
iam.ideM365Note: Already signed in to Kiro IDE with Microsoft 365 / Entra ID on this host? Import that local IDE credential directly as an Enterprise SSO account. This also sets the account proxy to direct so it mirrors the IDE path instead of the global proxy.
iam.importIdeM365: Import from Kiro IDE as Enterprise SSO - Microsoft 365
iam.importIdeM365Success: Imported Microsoft 365 Enterprise SSO from Kiro IDE

kirosso.openInstruction: A browser tab was opened. Sign in with your Microsoft 365 work/school account, then return here. Tip: use a guest/incognito window to avoid a cached session.

settings.traceAckRisk: I understand full mode stores prompts verbatim
settings.traceAckRiskHint: Without this, full mode degrades to redacted. Credentials are always scrubbed.
settings.traceCaptureModeHint: meta stores routing metadata only. redacted and full also store prompt/response bodies on disk.
settings.traceFullConfirm: Full capture stores user prompts verbatim on disk. Continue?
settings.traceMaxBodyBytesHint: Larger bodies are truncated and flagged. Default 262144 (256KB).
settings.traceRetentionHoursHint: Rotated trace files older than this are deleted. Default 168 (7 days).

settings.configDefaultPassword: Admin password is still the default. Change it before exposing this service.
settings.configNoAccounts: No accounts are configured. Use the import wizard or account import tools to recover credentials.
settings.configRestoreConfirm: Restore the latest config backup? Current config will be backed up first.
settings.externalUsageAutoDisableHint: When enabled, an account is automatically disabled for local routing the first time it is confirmed to be used outside this proxy (strong external usage). Reversible: re-enable it in Accounts. Does not affect the upstream Kiro account.
settings.filterPIIHint: Best-effort redaction of emails, SSNs, credit-card-like numbers, IPs, and API keys from the system prompt before it is sent upstream. May occasionally over-redact.
settings.metricsEnabledHint: Expose a public, unauthenticated Prometheus /metrics endpoint for scraping. Only aggregate operational gauges (no secrets). Enable only when the scrape path is protected by network policy.
settings.proxyFormatError: Each proxy must start with http://, https://, socks5://, or socks5h://
settings.proxyPoolHint: When set, the global proxy rotates through these round-robin, ignoring the single proxy above. Per-account proxies still take precedence. e.g. socks5://user:pass@host:port
settings.quotaAwareRoutingHint: When enabled, requests are routed to the account with the most remaining period quota instead of blind round-robin. Falls back to round-robin when quota data is unavailable.
settings.responseCacheHint: Cache identical non-streaming, tool-free, non-thinking requests to save upstream credits. Exact-match only; off by default.
settings.showPlaceholderReasoningHint: Some models (e.g. GPT-5.x / o-series) hide their raw reasoning and send only a "..." placeholder. Off (default) hides this empty placeholder; real reasoning from models that expose it always shows. Turn on to surface the raw placeholder.
settings.webhookURLHint: Optional. When set, security/warning events (account banned, external usage detected, auto-disable) are POSTed to this URL (Slack/Discord-compatible). Only safe fields are sent — never tokens, secrets, or prompts. Leave empty to disable.
tools.desc: Open recovery, diagnostics, and replay utilities only when you need to troubleshoot. The Accounts tab stays focused on the account list.
tools.title: Operational Tools
usageAudit.creditsNote: Measured in AWS agentic-request credits. There is no external token figure: upstream reports no token count for traffic this proxy did not originate, so "our tokens" covers only requests we served.
usageAudit.desc: Detects whether each account credential is used OUTSIDE this proxy (real Kiro IDE, another sharer). Compares upstream billing-period usage growth against the credits we metered in the same period.
usageAudit.noUpstream: No upstream usage data yet (refresh or recheck to establish a baseline).
usageAudit.title: Account Usage Audit
